facts.business: SC Agrotech Limited is engaged in the agriculture sector, providing agri-input products, farmer advisory programs, demonstration farms, and skill development workshops for farmers and rural youth.

auditor.name: Marks & Co. (Chartered Accountants)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company did not make available complete supporting documents, reconciliations and certain statutory records relating to selected transactions and balances, including GST, TDS, related party transactions, and certain expense accounts. Balance confirmations for certain trade receivables, trade payables and other balances were not available. Supporting documents such as reconciliations, agreements and detailed workings relating to certain balances and transactions were not fully made available. Unable to verify whether accounting software had audit trail (edit log) feature enabled and operating throughout the year for all relevant transactions per Rule 11(g).

key_risks: Incomplete supporting documents and statutory records for audit verification
Lack of balance confirmations for trade receivables and payables
Absence of audit trail (edit log) feature in accounting software
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions mentioned as one of the areas where complete supporting documents and reconciliations were not made available for audit verification.
